name: today.bcv/rates
title: BCV Today
description: Official Banco Central de Venezuela exchange rates (USD, EUR, CNY, TRY, RUB vs VES).
instructions: Free, public, read-only and stateless. No authentication. Rates are bolivars (VES) per one unit of each currency, as published by Banco Central de Venezuela. Unofficial project, not affiliated with the bank.

tools.name: get_latest_rates
tools.description: Official BCV rates currently in effect for USD, EUR, CNY, TRY and RUB, with effective date and capture time.

tools.name: get_rate_by_date
tools.description: Official BCV rate(s) in effect on a calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD), with weekend/holiday carry-forward explained.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Daily rate series for one currency (last N days or a date range) with min, max and percentage change.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert an amount between VES, USD, EUR, CNY, TRY and RUB using the latest or a given day's official rate.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Freshness of the published data: last update time, effective date and supported currencies.
